/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module <<'EOF'
import { chromium } from 'playwright'
const browser = await chromium.launch({headless:true})
const page = await browser.newPage()
page.on('response', response => { if (response.url().includes('catalog')) console.log(response.url(), response.request().headers()['next-router-prefetch'], response.status()) })
await page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:3000/')
console.log('loaded')
await page.waitForTimeout(5000)
await browser.close()
EOF"

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module <<'EOF'
import { chromium } from 'playwright'
import { instant } from '@next/playwright'
const browser = await chromium.launch({headless:true})
const page = await browser.newPage()
page.on('response', response => {if(response.url().includes('catalog')) console.log('response', response.url(), response.request().headers()['next-router-prefetch'])})
const prefetch = page.waitForResponse(response => { const url = new URL(response.url()); return url.pathname === '/catalog' && url.searchParams.get('category') === 'featured' && response.request().headers()['next-router-prefetch'] === '2' })
await page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:3000/')
console.log('loaded')
const response = await prefetch
console.log('prefetch response')
await response.finished()
console.log('prefetch finished')
await instant(page, async () => {
  console.log('locked')
  await page.locator('a[href=\"/catalog?category=featured\"]').click()
  console.log('clicked')
  await page.waitForURL(url => url.pathname === '/catalog' && url.searchParams.get('category') === 'featured', {timeout: 5000})
  console.log('navigated', await page.locator('body').innerText())
})
console.log('released')
await browser.close()
EOF"
